# ada-url / ada_c

ada-url's own fuzz target `ada_c` ([source](source/ada_c.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over ada (ada-url/ada at e6754478).

Checks 5 properties (listed below); the first, an API contract: C API: ada_can_parse(input) must equal ada_is_valid(ada_parse(input)); same for ada_can_parse_with_base vs ada_parse_with_base.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against ada at commit e6754478.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- ada_get_host_type() <= 2 and ada_get_scheme_type() <= 6 (enum range) ([lines 69-88](source/ada_c.cc#L69-L88)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
- Every url component offset (protocol_end .. hash_start) is either omitted (0xffffffff) or <= href length ([lines 100-114](source/ada_c.cc#L100-L114)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
- After a sequence of fuzzed setters and clear_* calls on a valid URL, ada_parse(href) must be valid and its href must equal the original href byte for byte ([lines 127-142](source/ada_c.cc#L127-L142)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
- C API: ada_can_parse(input) must equal ada_is_valid(ada_parse(input)); same for ada_can_parse_with_base vs ada_parse_with_base ([lines 159-178](source/ada_c.cc#L159-L178)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
- ada_get_version() is non-null; can_parse/parse agreement also re-checked on 4 fixed anchor URLs (constant inputs) ([lines 207-271](source/ada_c.cc#L207-L271)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
